comments.text:
The shops on Creek Street in Ketchikan stand on wooden posts over a creek, and every summer the salmon come up underneath them. Nobody built it as an attraction the town just grew over the water it was built beside.

Which of the three would you find strangest to live with: a tunnel you queue for, shops above a salmon run, or a ballgame that starts at ten at night?
